plan.title: UC inflamed vs control: Hallmark pathway activity heatmap
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is bulk RNA-seq (Salmon gene-level counts, 12000 genes x 13 sample columns / 12 samples after metadata reconciliation) comparing 6 ulcerative colitis inflamed colon samples vs 6 controls, unpaired, single batch. Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median and must be inspected, not silently dropped. The research question asks for (1) a pathway activity score per sample and (2) a heatmap of hallmark activity separating treated (UC inflamed) from control. This is a per-sample scoring task (GSVA on the reference-store MSigDB Hallmark gene sets), not a group-contrast differential-activity task, so the knowledge-service-grounded path is: QC -> filtering -> variance-stabilizing normalization -> GSVA hallmark scoring per sample -> limma test of the score matrix against condition (BH-adjusted across the 50 hallmark sets) -> annotated heatmap of the score matrix -> report. The knowledge check flagged GSVA+limma as not the permitted method under a 'pathway_activity' step type (which the knowledge base reserves for the PROGENy signalling-footprint method) but confirmed it as valid and violation-free once correctly typed as 'signature_scoring' with sample_scores as the enrichment input -- which is exactly what the research question asks for (a hallmark activity score per sample, not a PROGENy footprint of 14 signalling pathways). All packages (DESeq2, GSVA, limma, ComplexHeatmap) and the MSigDB Hallmark human GMT (50 sets, 2026.1 release) are confirmed present in this environment.
